content_sections.heading: CSTRI Project Assistant Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the CSTRI Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download CSTRI Project Assistant Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Assistant: Diploma in Textile Technology / Textile Engineering / Textile Chemistry / Silk Technology/ Handloom / Textile Technology or allied textile subjects from recognized University.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Project Assistant: Maximum age is 30 years. Age relaxation is applicable for a maximum period of 5 years for SC/ST/OBC, women, and physically challenged candidates.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for CSTRI Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Central Silk Technological Research Institute, Central Silk Board (CSTRI), a premier research institute operating in Bengaluru, Karnataka.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post announced in the notification?
faq.answer: The notified post is Project Assistant under temporary research projects managed by CSTRI in Bengaluru with a total vacancy count of 1 position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the selection procedure for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selection process entirely relies on a direct walk-in interview where candidates are evaluated based on their qualifications and performance during the interaction at the venue.

faq.question: Q4. When is the walk-in interview scheduled for CSTRI Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be conducted on 08 October 2026. Candidates are expected to arrive at the venue well before the reporting time.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for this role?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a Diploma in Textile Technology, Textile Engineering, Textile Chemistry, Silk Technology, Handloom, or allied textile subjects from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit and relaxation applicable for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 30 years as of the notification date. An age relaxation of up to 5 years is applicable for SC, ST, OBC, women, and physically challenged candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary or stipend offered for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Project Assistant position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs.20,000/- throughout the tenure of the temporary assignment.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required to apply or attend the walk-in?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned in the official notification, making it entirely free for eligible candidates to participate in the walk-in interview drive.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates bring to the walk-in venue?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring a duly filled application form, passport-size photographs, original certificates, and attested photocopies of all educational documents starting from 10th standard onwards.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview location situated?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will take place at the Central Silk Technological Research Institute located in Bengaluru, Karnataka, with the pincode 560068 as per the official notification guidelines.
